sources.title: Odisha Tourism: Dhauli Shanti Stupa
sources.note: The current overview dates the pagoda to the 1970s, retells the Daya river story and describes a light-and-sound show. It does not confirm a programme for your travel date.

sources.title: National Monuments Authority: Dhauli site history and description
sources.note: Draft heritage document, pp. 8–9, sections 3.2–3.3: dating, language and script, edict arrangement and elephant placement. Used for historical description, not current access rules.

sources.title: Ven. S. Dhammika: The Edicts of King Asoka
sources.note: English rendering, Buddhist Publication Society, 1993; Access to Insight edition. See Kalinga Rock Edict 1 and note 30, Major Rock Edict XIII and note 25. The preface explains its reliance on earlier translations and differences between readings.
